content:
Since each full forward trip carries 40 buns, he can make at most \(200/40 = 5\) forward trips while carrying full loads.

Use 4 round trips and 1 final one-way trip.

- Each round trip nets \(40 - 1 - 1 = 38\) buns at the site.
- The final one-way trip delivers \(40 - 1 = 39\) buns.

Total:
\[
4 \cdot 38 + 39 = 152 + 39 = 191
\]

\[
\boxed{191}
\]
